title: Nondegenerate cell presentation and subset embeddings of simplicial realization
statement: Let $K$ be a small simplicial set with geometric realization as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and let $q_\sigma:|\Delta^n|\to|K|$ be its continuous characteristic map for $\sigma\in K_n$. Every point of $|K|$ has a unique representative $(\sigma,t)$ with $\sigma$ nondegenerate and all barycentric coordinates of $t$ strictly positive; thus these images of simplex interiors are pairwise disjoint and cover $|K|$. Every simplex $\tau\in K_n$ is a degeneracy of a unique nondegenerate simplex $\sigma\in K_m$: there is an order-preserving surjection $\alpha:[n]\twoheadrightarrow[m]$ with $\tau=K(\alpha)(\sigma)$, and $q_\tau=q_\sigma\circ\alpha_*$, where $(\alpha_*t)_j=\sum_{\alpha(i)=j}t_i$. For every order-preserving map $\beta:[m]\to[n]$, the realization relation is $q_{K(\beta)(\sigma)}=q_\sigma\circ\beta_*$, where $(\beta_*t)_j=\sum_{\beta(i)=j}t_i$. A subset $B\subseteq|K|$ is closed if and only if $q_\tau^{-1}(B)$ is closed in $|\Delta^n|$ for every simplex $\tau\in K_n$. For a simplicial subset $A\subseteq K$, the inclusion-induced map $|A|\to|K|$ is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset, and its image consists exactly of the points whose nondegenerate representative belongs to $A$. Here a simplicial subset is a family of subsets of $K_n$ stable under all face and degeneracy maps, and nondegenerate means not in the image of a degeneracy map.
